patterns.description: Slide presents a left-aligned title plus three vertically stacked feature cards on the right, each card pairing a fixed icon badge with a heading and a body line.
Each card text object holds two semantic paragraphs: paragraph 0 is the card heading (18pt) and paragraph 1 is the body (14pt), supporting separate title/body slots.
The arrow icon badges (background shape plus arrow image) are treated as fixed decorative branding elements rather than replaceable content.

constraints.description: Card text objects consistently expose exactly two paragraphs (heading then body); editing should target these two fields rather than the whole object.
